spec.behavior: Serve a tiny single-process JSON key-value HTTP service. GET /health returns health, PUT /kv/<key> stores the raw request body, GET /kv/<key> reads it or returns a 404 JSON error, and GET /shutdown returns a goodbye response then exits cleanly. Every response uses Content-Type application/json.

jet.notes: Uses raw process.argv plus Shared guards and a serve_once_listener loop. package authority expands the supplied probe budget with Exec, Mem.Rc, and Panic because argv/shared state require them. Default jet run fails verbatim with E0956: HTTP server callback registration requires a host callback marshaller; jet build AOT passes on the requested port. jet run --release passes only when probed on fallback port 18080: forwarded port 18113 was not visible to process.argv, causing connection refused and then E3001 on the idle listener. An initial AOT smoke found shared read-guard deadlock at shutdown and a one-element sentinel alignment bug; both were fixed. L0202 shared_auto_clone remains a warning.
